name: drift-check
context_rationale: Drift-check compares vault files against code reality using file inputs and code-review-graph queries with no dependency on the current session's conversational state, making it fully mechanically runnable as a pre-commit hook or fresh-context subagent.
summary: Audits vault claims against code reality and flags divergence across three categories: DRIFT (blocker), UNSPECIFIED CODE (major), and STALE CLAIM (major). Runs in fast mode for pre-commit hooks or full mode for on-demand audits. Appends findings to drift-log.json via the R-32 safe channel and supports interactive --resolve mode. Designed as the detect-only, all-modes counterpart to the Heavy-mode-only /sync skill.

reads.purpose: Load accepted ADR claims (tech choices, library choices) to verify against code
Read risks claimed retired to verify retirement is real
Active slices only: verify design file references against actual code
Active slices only: check must-not-defer items are implemented
Heavy mode: include component doc claims in drift audit
Heavy mode: include contract endpoint signature claims in drift audit
Heavy mode: include schema field claims in drift audit

outputs.purpose: Append full-mode audit entry with findings and resolutions (R-32 seam-routed, ADR-103)

tools.name: vault_edit
tools.purpose: Append drift audit entry to drift-log.md (R-32 seam-routed channel, ADR-103, append-only)

tools.name: cross_spec_parity_audit
tools.purpose: Heavy-mode only: validate cross-spec Implementation/Verification references in threat-model.md/requirements.md/nfrs.md (CSP-1)

tools.name: code-review-graph
tools.purpose: Code graph via code-review-graph (CRG) — reachability / blast-radius / keyword+semantic search via CRG MCP tools. Replaces graphify; vault-graph & multimodal-ingest uses dropped.
tools.note: External pip package (github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph), MCP-native; graph stored in .code-review-graph/. Replaces graphify.

harness_tools.name: Read

harness_tools.name: Grep
harness_tools.purpose: Fallback verification of ADR claims when code-review-graph is unavailable

harness_tools.name: Glob

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Run git diff --name-only HEAD for --fast mode scoping; run drift-check as pre-commit hook script
